description.zh:
是否进行证脸质量检测
- T：表示需要检测
- F：表示需要检测（默认F）
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform face quality detection on the ID document. Valid values:
- T: Perform face quality detection.
- F: Do not perform face quality detection. This is the default value.
The Base64-encoded image of the front side of the ID document. The value is a Base64 encoding of the image.
The URL of the front-side image of the ID document.

description.zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
description.en: The merchant-defined unique business ID used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can be a combination of letters and digits with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure that the value is unique.

description.zh: 商户用户ID，或可用于识别特定用户的其他标识符，例如手机号码、电子邮件地址等。强烈建议对userId字段的值进行预脱敏处理，例如对该值进行hash处理
description.en: The merchant user ID or another identifier that can be used to identify a specific user, such as a phone number or email address. We strongly recommend that you pre-desensitize the value of the userId field, for example, by hashing the value.

description.zh:
是否进行证件OCR
- T：表示需要证件OCR（默认T）
- F：表示不需要
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform OCR on the ID document. Valid values:
- T: Perform OCR on the ID document. This is the default value.
- F: Do not perform OCR.

description.zh:
是否开启防伪检测
- T：表示开启防伪
- F：表示关闭（默认F）
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable anti-spoofing detection. Valid values:
- T: Enable anti-spoofing detection.
- F: Disable anti-spoofing detection. This is the default value.
